name: P-015 R-3 live-plane observation on the STAGING operator (2026-09-24d): ideate on/off stack transition served by :3170 6f2044817d, desired->prepared->applied receipts, coord:orient leaves a pending activation for turn-start (WI-10002717), actor/principal stability, per-layer span join

The script's own psql -f call failed with "Permission denied" (the postgres role cannot read a file under the observer's home), so the unedited q-all.sql was re-run read-only on stdin. The generated window 2026-09-24T17:55:00Z - 2026-09-24T17:55:27Z was used as written: v5 rounds the window end up, so no bound was corrected.
timeBasis: startedAt is the :3170 /api/health read that opened the drill (sha 6f2044817d); finishedAt is the drill's own done stamp. The drill window used by q-all.sql is 2026-09-24T17:55:00Z - 2026-09-24T17:55:27Z. Snapshots use database clock_timestamp() between steps.
summary: Doc 2026-09-24c (build 4be87080b9) predates identity-management.ts a21a5e1b59 (su-9a43633d P-005 batch, committed 2026-09-24 16:47Z), a measured R-3 source path, so its bindings 11619-11622 went freshness-stale. identity-grants-port.ts is unchanged (150edc7d8d). This drill ran the same ideate on/off transition through :3170 at 6f2044817d, whose four R-3 source blobs equal canonical HEAD and the working tree. Each transition first called coord:orient {afterCompaction}; both times orient returned ok and the activation stayed pending (status desired, delivered watermark not advanced). The turn-start boundary then wrote prepared and applied. Enabling ideate produced generation 162 (desired 19599, prepared 19600, applied 19601) and disabling it produced generation 163 (19602 / 19603 / 19604). Every event carries actor == owner, principal system:superuser and adv session 29827. The gen-162 activation opened 3 layer spans, including ideation:su.mode-ideate, closed exactly when gen 163 applied; gen 163 opened 2 without ideation. All seven drill tool calls were served by port-3170 at 6f2044817d.

subject.note: The observer's own psu session. The transient ideate overlay was enabled and disabled within 27 seconds purely as a stack transition to observe; the session's AUTO mode was unchanged throughout.

sourceBlobs.basis: git rev-parse <ref>:<path>; identical in 6f2044817d (the papercusp-staging checkout :3170 serves), canonical HEAD a48f6294fb and the working tree

replication.sql: \pset footer off \echo === q-activation (events > baseline 19598, drill window 2026-09-24T17:55:00Z - 2026-09-24T17:55:27Z) SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, e.id, e.control_generation AS gen, e.phase, e.source, e.stack_refs, left(e.specification_revision,12) AS spec, left(e.state_revision,12) AS state, e.adv_session_id AS adv, e.actor_id = e.owner_id AS actor_is_owner, e.principal_id, e.failure, e.recorded_at FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events e WHERE e.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND e.owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND e.id > 19598 AND e.recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-24T17:55:00Z' AND '2026-09-24T17:55:27Z' ORDER BY e.id; SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, control_generation, control_delivered_generation, control_state->'activation'->>'status' AS status FROM harness_shared.session_briefs WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace'; \echo === q-spans (spans opened by the drill applied events) SELECT count(*) AS span_count_now FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd'; SELECT activation_event_id, control_generation, actor_id, principal_id, layer_slot, layer_ref, active_from, active_until FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND activation_event_id IN (SELECT id FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND id > 19598 AND phase='applied' AND recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-24T17:55:00Z' AND '2026-09-24T17:55:27Z') ORDER BY activation_event_id, layer_slot; \echo === q-serving (tool calls served inside the drill window) SELECT id, tool_name, status, serving_host, serving_build_sha, invoked_at FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE id > 29442987 AND coord_owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND invoked_at BETWEEN '2026-09-24T17:55:00Z' AND '2026-09-24T17:55:27Z' ORDER BY id; \echo === q-usage (usage samples attributed to the drill activations) SELECT id, to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) AS at, source, model_class, session_id, identity_activation_event_id, identity_owner_id FROM harness_shared.agent_usage_samples_identity_attribution WHERE ts BETWEEN (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-24T17:55:00Z')*1000)::bigint AND (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-24T17:55:27Z')*1000)::bigint AND (identity_owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' OR session_id ILIKE '%38e71009%' OR identity_activation_event_id IN (SELECT id FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND id > 19598 AND phase='applied')) ORDER BY id;

assertions.evidence: Served by :3170 6f2044817d. mode:set ideate=on (17:55:01.936Z-17:55:06.156Z) wrote 19599 desired gen 162 (spec 3342f6ca0f3e, state ac868549f9fa, stack autonomy:su.mode-auto + fleet-posture:su.fleet-member + ideation:su.mode-ideate). The turn-start boundary (17:55:12.667Z-17:55:13.729Z) then wrote 19600 prepared and 19601 applied with the same revision pair. mode:set ideate=off wrote 19602 desired gen 163 (spec 3342f6ca0f3e, state 47ab41da7d2a, stack autonomy:su.mode-auto + fleet-posture:su.fleet-member); its turn-start (17:55:23.445Z-17:55:25.873Z) wrote 19603 prepared and 19604 applied. session_briefs after each turn-start: 162/162 applied, then 163/163 applied.

WI-10002717 live check on the new build. Before each turn-start the drill called coord:orient {afterCompaction:true} through :3170 (17:55:06.282Z-17:55:12.580Z and 17:55:16.428Z-17:55:23.352Z). Both returned ok:true. The snapshots straight after them read generation/delivered/status 162/161/desired (2026-09-24 13:55:12.661626-04) and 163/162/desired (2026-09-24 13:55:23.439022-04): the delivery watermark was NOT advanced and the activation stayed pending until the turn-start boundary.

All six events carry actor_id == owner_id, principal_id system:superuser and adv_session_id 29827, with no failure. The 5 spans opened by 19601/19604 carry the same actor and principal. The transition did not re-attribute the session.

session_identity_layer_spans for the owner: activation 19601 (gen 162) opened 3 spans (autonomy:su.mode-auto, fleet-posture:su.fleet-member, ideation:su.mode-ideate), active 2026-09-24 13:55:12.765772-04 - 2026-09-24 13:55:23.825241-04. Activation 19604 (gen 163) opened 2 (autonomy:su.mode-auto, fleet-posture:su.fleet-member) from 2026-09-24 13:55:23.825241-04, still open at read time, with no ideation span. The ideation layer is attributable to exactly the 11-second window its activation was applied. Usage join (usage-attribution.txt, read 2026-09-24T17:59:17.641Z): no sample has joined onto a drill activation yet.

tool_invocations for the owner in 2026-09-24T17:55:00Z - 2026-09-24T17:55:27Z: all seven drill calls (mode:set x2, coord:orient x2, state:read x2, work_items:get) carry serving_host port-3170 and serving_build_sha 6f2044817d, as do the reads coord:orient fans out to (coord:catch-up, coord:glance, coord:inbox, coord:plan-events, coord:whoami, fleet:assignments, plans:get, work_items:list, work_items:observe). The 5 non-3170 rows in the window are the observer session's own concurrent calls (dev:pg_query, activity:report, capability:bash); none is a mode or activation write.

The :3170 turn-start-memory responses carried both payloads. 12 (after ideate on): ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ reason next-generation, generations 161->162, with ⟦stack⟧ attach ops for ideation. It is a delta, not a full resync, because the delivered watermark equalled the generation at drill start (snapshot 00-baseline 161/161/applied), so the pending transition's previousGeneration 161 matched it; decideControlTransitionDelivery (control-anchor.ts) delivers the delta in that case. 17 (after ideate off): ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ reason next-generation, 162->163, with a ⟦stack⟧ detach op for slot ideation.
